description: This file defines a final class GetBucketLocationResultMutator that implements a custom mutator for the AWS S3 SDK to extract and inject bucket location data into the result based on the response body of a GetBucketLocation request.

classes.name: GetBucketLocationResultMutator
classes.description: A final class that mutates the result of a GetBucketLocation request by parsing the response body and setting the LocationConstraint field.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the mutator, checks if the command is GetBucketLocation, extracts location info from the response body, and updates the result accordingly.
